controls.name: fixed-preset TTS control
controls.role: Kokoro 82M uses one `af_heart` preset with no reference voice; it shows what text-only fixed-voice synthesis costs and is not a cloning candidate.

controls.name: reference clip as identity ceiling
controls.role: The unmodified reference clip is the identity ceiling; any synthesized-output similarity must be reported against it, not as an absolute quality score.

controls.name: wrong/mismatched reference control
controls.role: A mismatched reference voice is required to expose whether output follows the reference or collapses to a generic voice; it was not run.

controls.name: content-preservation ASR control
controls.role: Whisper Tiny English WER 0.00% on the fixed 27-word text is a one-utterance proxy for content, not comprehension, naturalness or pronunciation gold.

controls.name: ignore-reference / degenerate voice control
controls.role: A synthesizer that ignores the reference and emits a fixed voice must be distinguishable from a reference-conditioned one; no such ablation exists.

controls.name: sample-count, finite-output and clipping control
controls.role: Historical outputs are finite, non-clipping 24 kHz waveforms with recorded durations; sample-count preservation and nonfinite handling are not exercised by this survey.

controls.name: single vs multi-utterance and single vs multi-speaker stratification
controls.role: Every historical run is one text and one reference; no multi-utterance, multi-speaker or language-group stratification exists.

controls.name: optional TTS branch versus required ASR→TTS replacement
controls.role: TTS is an optional branch; it must not be presented as a required replacement for the call's speech path.

controls.name: streaming chunks versus whole-utterance return
controls.role: CosyVoice 2 exposes four chunks; Chatterbox Nano returns a whole utterance with no chunks. Chunked return is not the same as measured first-audio latency.

excluded_boundaries.reason: Changing the timbre of supplied speech retains the input content and timing; it is not text-conditioned synthesis in a reference voice.
A pronunciation change on an existing utterance is not a generated waveform from text plus a reference voice.

excluded_boundaries.boundary: Pitch and limited prosody control (TRN-02) and time-scale modification (TRN-01)
excluded_boundaries.reason: Pitch, duration and rate controls modify a supplied waveform; they do not generate speech from text.
A transcript is text, not a synthesized waveform, and ASR→TTS is an optional composition rather than a required call replacement.
An identity score or embedding is not a generated utterance; similarity scoring must stay separate from synthesis quality.

excluded_boundaries.boundary: Background noise suppression (CLN-01) and quality assessment (OBS-01)
excluded_boundaries.reason: A denoised signal or a perceptual score is not reference-conditioned TTS.
